constraints: The archive drive is mounted at /var/mnt/sn3000, and the old home is /var/mnt/sn3000/home/walton.
Every path these intents name is absent from the new drive, so carrying one over writes where nothing is.
A credential carried over from the archive may be older than one issued since the drive was swapped.
The rest of the old home is agent scratch and large caches, and no intent here reaches it.
The .ssh directory and the App Store Connect signing key were carried over already and are no part of this.
The key the rebuild left at ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 was a new one labelled as restored, so what a rebuild says it carried over is worth checking against the archive.
